governing.title: Notice; waiver
governing.why: Waiver of notice by an interested person.

governing.title: Waiver of notice
governing.why: Waiver of notice in guardianship/conservatorship matters.

considerations.title: Notice; waiver
considerations.note: A competent interested person may waive notice in writing.

transition_18a: Procedural form under current Title 18-C and the Maine Rules of Probate Procedure; the date-of-death substantive transition rules are generally not implicated, though the underlying estate or guardianship matter carries its own transition posture.
